jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
At Dscout, we’re building the most flexible and powerful UX research platform on the market—trusted by the world’s top brands in finance (JP Morgan Chase, Intuit, Charles Schwab, PayPal), healthcare (Aya, Headspace), consumer goods (Keen, Verizon, Target, Northface), and tech (Google, Amazon, Facebook, Meta, Spotify, AirBnB). Our tools help teams deeply understand the humans behind their products, so they can build better ones. We are expanding our smart and driven team and would love for you to join us. 
 
 We’re looking for smart and driven DevOps Engineers to help scale our platform. You have experience with AWS infrastructure and beyond and have seen a couple (or more) different ways to do it. You are fully bought into IaC (Infrastructure as Code), have used one of the popular tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc), and are excited to help us evolve our infrastructure automation. 
 You have a product mindset and have a history of working with application developers, Quality Engineers, and Security & Compliance teams to understand their needs, prioritize them, and deliver DevOps solutions that address those. You use AI coding tools daily, and like everything else you ship, you trust the output only as far as you've verified it. You are also data driven and use metrics to drive your decisions. 
 You are capable of juggling many tasks involving future projects, support requests, and SRE duties — including being a primary responder to production incidents, since compliance limits production access on many systems to DevOps. 
 Our team is growing but we’re not a big company. We work collaboratively, move fast (we deploy to production many times a day), and we value technical quality. If you are excited about the challenge of building a platform that powers an incredible product while working alongside a great engineering team, we’d love to hear from you! 
  the job  
  what you will do  
 
 Be an active member of the DevOps team 
 Work with a product mindset where the rest of Engineering are your customers 
 Collaborate with teammates to continuously improve the ways you and your team work 
 Design & implement DevOps solutions using a modern toolset 
 Use metrics and data to drive communication and decisions 
 Be responsible for the platform stability and help inform application architecture decisions in that context 
 Actively partner with AppEng to support production incidents 
 Deliver platform changes in an iterative way and with no downtime 
 Work with the Principal DevOps Engineer, VP of Compliance, and Chief Architect on defining & adopting security best practices & solutions 
 Be a part of our on-call rotation 
 
  what you need to have  
 
 4-6 years experience in any engineering role 
 At least 2 years of experience in a DevOps engineer role specifically 
 Expertise with designing, creating, and managing AWS infrastructure 
 Expertise with using IaC tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, etc) to manage cloud infrastructure 
 Experience using AI coding tools to improve ops automation without compromising security or reliability 
 Experience with Linux, shell scripting, and a scripting language 
 Experience with modern tools like Docker, GitHub, CircleCI/RWX, etc 
 Understanding of how DevOps design influences, enables, and constrains application architecture and SDLC 
 Experience with observability tools (logs, metrics, tracing), troubleshooting, monitoring, and alarming 
 Solid understanding of security principles and how to design with security-first approach 
 
 This position is open to candidates who are legally authorized to work in the United States and who will be located in the US by their start date.

Role Description 
 As a Technical Architect at  Dropbox , you will help enterprise customers translate business goals and complex technical requirements into practical solution architectures. You will work with customers and internal teams to design how Dropbox fits into their existing systems, validate critical assumptions, and guide implementation and adoption. 
 You will lead architecture discussions spanning workflows, integrations, identity and access, data movement, and operational readiness. You will explain design choices and tradeoffs, identify technical risks early, and produce clear guidance that implementation teams can act on. You will also turn lessons from customer engagements into reusable patterns and actionable feedback for Product and Engineering. 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Lead technical discovery with customer business and IT stakeholders to establish requirements, constraints, dependencies, and measurable success criteria. 
 Design and document solution architectures, including system boundaries, integration and data flows, identity and permission models, and operational requirements. 
 Evaluate design options and explain tradeoffs in reliability, security, performance, implementation effort, and ongoing cost. 
 Validate high-risk assumptions through focused prototypes, integration tests, or technical evaluations with explicit acceptance criteria. 
 Guide implementation and migration planning, defining sequencing, owners, testing, cutover, rollback, and handoff to delivery and support teams. 
 Partner with Customer Success, Support, Sales, Product, and Engineering to resolve technical blockers and connect architecture decisions to customer outcomes. 
 Create reusable reference architectures, implementation guidance, and enablement materials; mentor colleagues and communicate recurring product gaps. 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Customer-facing technical experience: At least 3 years in technical architecture, solutions architecture, implementation consulting, or a similar role, leading discovery, solution design, demonstrations, and technical validation for enterprise SaaS customers. 
 AI experience: Experience using AI tools for technical analysis, solution design, or prototyping, including validating outputs, protecting customer data, and assessing limitations. 
 Integration expertise: Experience designing and troubleshooting API integrations, authentication, data flows, and failure handling. 
 Identity and access: Understanding of IAM and Zero Trust principles, including SSO, SAML, OAuth/OIDC, SCIM, MFA, RBAC, conditional access, and how permissions and sharing affect data exposure. 
 Implementation and migration: Experience planning implementations or migrations and coordinating dependencies, technical risks, and handoffs across teams. 
 Technical communication: Ability to write clear technical documentation, lead workshops, and explain design decisions to technical and business audiences. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Expertise in at least one of the following areas: 
 
 
  CASB/SSE/DLP platforms:  Experience with enterprise security platforms such as Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Forcepoint, Broadcom/Symantec DLP, or similar technologies. 
 
 
  Identity and access management:  Experience with platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or Ping Identity, including managing identities, permissions, and groups and applying least-privilege access principles to SaaS applications. 
 
 
  Security ecosystems and integrations:  Experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms, APIs, OAuth, event and audit logs, or security integrations, including an understanding of how SaaS and data security solutions fit into a customer’s broader security architecture. 
 
 
  Security and compliance frameworks:  Experience applying frameworks or regulatory requirements such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS to address enterprise customer needs.

Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more. 
 
 We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA. 
 
 Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era. 
 
  About the role  
 We're hiring a  Field Marketing Manager  to own Infisical's events, both in person and online. You'll run our conference program end to end and build our webinars and partner events into a steady source of pipeline. You'll also work closely with sales before and after each event, so the people we meet turn into meetings and opportunities. 
 You'll report to our Marketing lead and join an agile team where your work has immediate impact and ideas are tried. While field and event marketing will be your core focus, our fast-paced environment means you'll regularly collaborate across functions, which can mean stepping in to support strategic campaigns, experiment with innovative tools, and drive growth initiatives beyond the scope of traditional event management. 
 
  What you'll do  
 
  Own our conference program  
 
 
 Decide which conferences we go to and how big we go at each one, from a small table to a custom booth 
 
 
 Own the events budget and decide where the money goes 
 
 
 Manage booth vendors, shipping, swag, staffing, and on-site logistics for events like KubeCon, RSAC, AWS re:Invent, and more

 Cultivate strategic relationships with key event organizers to secure prime booth locations and high-visibility speaking opportunities

 Work with sales before each event to agree on target accounts and book meetings on site 
 
 
 Run pre-event outreach so the right people know where to find us 
 
 
 Build post-event follow-up with sales and growth marketing, including sales sequences and email nurture, so the people we meet hear from us quickly and more than once 
 
 
  Grow our digital events and partnerships  
 
 
 Run our webinar program, from topic and speakers through promotion and follow-up 
 
 
 Source and run co-marketing webinars with partners and other developer tools in our space 
 
 
 Support our community meetups alongside our startup and ecosystem team 
 
 
  Work across the team  
 
 
 Work with our growth marketer on digital promotion for events 
 
 
 Work with our content marketing manager on event materials and booth content 
 
 
 Look into new tools that could make events and follow-up run better, and help us set them up 
 
 
  What we're looking for

 Experience managing booth vendors, event budgets, and logistics across several events at once 
 
 
 You like working closely with sales and keeping both teams on the same plan 
 
 
 You keep track of vendor deadlines, shipping dates, and registration cutoffs without anyone reminding you 
 
 
 You're scrappy. If we ask you to look into a new tool or help on a campaign outside events, you'll jump into it 
 
 
 Clear, friendly communication with sales, partners, and vendors 
 
 
 Based in the US and able to travel regularly for key events 
 
 
  Nice to have

You will also turn lessons from customer engagements into reusable patterns and actionable feedback for Product and Engineering.
